rule: All eight are light, sense 1, and none of them reaches the head's three other lexical senses — gems (2), blades (3) or trousers (4). What sense 1 shows is how modern the vocabulary is: a unit of distance (ปีแสง), two polar phenomena (แสงเหนือ, แสงใต้), a botanical process (สังเคราะห์แสง), an optical property (โปร่งแสง), a beam (ลำแสง), the last light at sunset (ยอแสง), and หิวแสง, 'light-hungry' — wanting the spotlight, which is new slang built on the oldest sense.
